data_points.notes: SCOPE CAVEAT: IMARC scope = sprays, roll-ons, creams, gels, wipes, sticks and others. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated; the source notes competition from both organised and unorganised players but does not say which its sizing covers. Value is rounded to one decimal by the source (USD 1.0bn), so precision is low.
IMARC: USD 1.0bn (2025) to USD 1.4bn (2034), CAGR 3.10% 2026-2034. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated.

"India Deodorant Market is set to grow at a CAGR of around 7.80% during 2026-2035", base year 2025. Scope = gel, cream, spray, roll-on, stick, wipes, others; branded products across supermarkets, hypermarkets, convenience stores and online. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated. CONFLICT: cf IMARC 3.10% (2026-2034) and Bonafide Research 9.13% (2024-2029) — the three forecasts span 3.10-9.13% on essentially the same product scope. Do not average.

"forecasted to grow at over 9.13% CAGR from 2024 to 2029". Scope = spray, roll-on, gel, stick, creams, wipes, others; offline + online. No base-year value is disclosed on the teaser page, so no market_size claim is recorded from this source. Organised/unorganised coverage not stated. CONFLICT: cf IMARC 3.10% (2026-2034) and Expert Market Research 7.80% (2026-2035) — a ~3x spread between the extremes. 6Wresearch publishes the same 9.13% figure but states no year range on its page, so it is treated as the same underlying estimate rather than independent corroboration. Do not average.
